description: Match a working paper's title and optional abstract against currently open calls for papers, ranked by topic fit. Returns at most 10 open calls with their deadline, submission type, eligibility, matched topics, ResearchCal page and official source URL. Paper text is processed only in memory and never stored.

field.description: Research field key, for example 'economics', 'business', 'finance' or 'political_science'. See server instructions or list_calendars for the current fields.
field.title: Field

limit.description: Maximum open calls to return (1 to 10).
limit.title: Limit

region.description: World region: europe, north_america, latin_america, asia, mena, africa or oceania.
region.title: Region

name: match_paper

cross_field_note.description: Non-empty when this call is in a neighboring field.
cross_field_note.title: Cross Field Note

dates.description: Event dates as text, or empty.
dates.title: Dates

deadline_type.description: full_paper, extended_abstract, abstract, panel_proposal, call_for_works, application, or empty when not yet typed.
deadline_type.title: Deadline Type

id.description: Event id. Pass it to fetch for details.
id.title: Id

matched_topics.description: Topics shared between the paper and this call.
matched_topics.title: Matched Topics

source_url.description: Official call for papers or event page.
source_url.title: Source Url

who_may_submit.description: Who may submit, for example 'PhD students only' or 'Open to everyone'; empty when not checked.
who_may_submit.title: Who May Submit

matched_topics.description: Canonical topics extracted from the paper.
matched_topics.title: Matched Topics

primary_field.description: Inferred or requested research field key, or empty.
primary_field.title: Primary Field

title: Match paper to open calls
